brief:
The user enjoys comedy because it makes them laugh and usually does not need a sensible plotline. They described one favorite comedy as funny overall, but its title was inaudible and remains unknown.

They dislike drama, saying they already have enough drama in their own life and do not enjoy thinking about other people’s problems, referring to clichéd problems in dramas. They could not name a specific disliked movie at the time.

When the assistant asked about Stepbrothers, the user confirmed having seen it and liked the pairing of the lead actors. They named Will Ferrell but could not recall the other actor’s name, saying the two were a good combination and that this was why they liked the film.
